fl_alice_wainwright_park.blurb: A small waterfront park on Brickell Avenue, just south of downtown Miami, with a low limestone ledge that climbers use for bouldering. The rock is pocketed and full of holds, so the fun is in setting your own limits on which ones to use. Eleven problems are listed, almost all at the very easy end, around V0, with a single V1, a single V2 and a lone VB. It suits beginners, kids and anyone wanting a casual warm-up while visiting Florida rather than a serious bouldering destination. Most of the wall sits in the sun, which keeps the surface clean but makes summer sessions hot. Watch for critters living in the holes.
